data.title: FDIC Appoints Sunwest Bank as Nano Banc's Acquiring Institution

The FDIC took over the receivership of Nano Banc from the Department of Financial Protection and Innovation (DFPI). This acquisition took place on September 25, 2026.

data.title: Sabre Corporation Announces Early Tender Results of Previously Announced Cash Tender Offer and Consent Solicitation by Sabre Financial Borrower, LLC

data.title: MagLev Aero Secures Dual DARPA Contracts to Advance Next-Generation U.S. Drone Propulsion
data.description: MagLev Aero has recently received funding from DARPA to speed up their advancement to TRL-6 flight readiness, reducing risks associated with commercializing their technology. This funding will also aid in progressing U.S.-manufactured propulsion for American "Drone Dominance" efforts. The funding was announced on Sept. 25, 2026, in Boston.

data.title: Deep Fission Rejects Distortions in Short-Seller Report
data.description: PARSONS, Kansas - Deep Fission, Inc. (Nasdaq: FISN) faced criticism yesterday in a short-seller report, with the Company claiming it to be misleading. The report, targeted at Deep Fission and its technology, is said to contain several distortions, inaccuracies, and mischaracterizations according to the Company's response. The report's disclaimer highlights that its contents are opinions and not facts, emphasizing they were not provided by insiders or connected persons from Deep Fission.

data.title: CORRECTING and REPLACING PHOTO Planet’s Pelican-12 Satellite Arrives at Launch Site
data.description: In San Francisco, Planet Labs PBC revealed that Pelican-12, the second-generation high-resolution Pelican™ satellite, has reached the Cape Canaveral Space Force Station in Florida for its upcoming launch on the Bandwagon-5 rideshare mission. Planet Labs PBC, known for offering daily data spotlighting Earth's transformations, announced the latest satellite's arrival. Pelican-12, an updated Gen 2 satellite, signifies a milestone for the company. The satellite's journey to the launch site in Florida marks a significant step before its deployment into orbit.

data.title: Masco Corporation Chairman Emeritus, Richard Manoogian, Passes at the Age of 90
data.description: In Livonia, Michigan, Masco Corporation (NYSE: MAS) revealed the passing of their Chairman Emeritus, Richard Manoogian, on September 25, 2026, at the age of 90. Richard, the son of Alex and Marie Manoogian, was instrumental in the success of Masco Corporation. His father, Alex, an Armenian immigrant and the company's founder, introduced the single-handle Delta® faucet to the market, which has become a prominent brand in the home improvement and remodeling sector. Richard commenced his journey with Masco in 1958, showcasing outstanding leadership abilities throughout his tenure.

The sale highlights the attractiveness of the North Phoenix real estate market for institutional investors, reflecting a growing trend in the industry.
